THRESHOLD. break stays 78, deliberately below the 79.14 % measured, not at
100. A threshold above the real score is a gate that fails on green and
gets disabled; the ~1.1pp of slack (about 19 mutants) absorbs the 10
timeout-classified mutants in ResilienceExecutor/Atomics, whose
classification depends on host load and would otherwise flip the gate on a
busy runner. The score moved 79.41 -> 79.14 because the Setup.cs mutants
that used to be discarded are now counted, and 5 of them survive; that is a
more honest number over a larger denominator, not a regression. Ratchet
break upward as survivors are killed, never down.
